category: rotating residential proxy (per GB) and static residential (per IP)

free_tier.stated: No free tier stated. The pricing index lists Residential Proxies-GB from $0.55/GB, Static Residential Proxies from $3.5/IP (Native), Mobile Proxies from $1.45/GB, Residential Proxies-IP from $0.03/IP, Unlimited Proxies by port from $1/port with a 'Trial' badge, and SOCKS5 Proxies from $30/15 days.
free_tier.notes: The 'Trial' badge on the by-port unlimited product is the only trial marker on the index; its terms were not readable.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an address or a traffic quota, not an object

retention.stated: not applicable: a proxy session or a rented address, not stored bytes

egress.terms: Residential Proxies-GB is 'Pay per GB' with 'Rotating & sticky sessions'; the unlimited by-port product does not restrict traffic volume or the number of IPs, with bandwidth fixed by plan tier.

interface_detail: HTTP(S) and SOCKS5 forward proxy; residential, unlimited and SOCKS5 products accept username and password or IP whitelisting, static residential accepts username and password only; 'API reselling support' is listed on the GB product.
tooling: Any client that speaks an HTTP(S) or SOCKS5 proxy with a username and password or an allowlisted source address: curl -x, python requests, rclone --socks5, or a host-side hop for a runtime that cannot dial a proxy itself.
chaining: A host-side hop dials the vendor's HTTP(S) or SOCKS5 endpoint with credentials; the upstream sees an address from the vendor's pool in place of the caller's address.

limits.value: Residential Proxies-GB from $0.55/GB, '+5% GB' bonus badge
Unlimited Proxies by port: 5 Mbps per port, 3 to 30 minute rotation, from $1/port

limits_note: Static residential per-IP prices from the static page: $3.50/IP for most US cities, $3.90/IP for 'Dual NTT' lines, $4.90/IP for the California Comcast line, with quantity discounts of 2% at 5-9 IPs up to 20% at 200-499 IPs. The pool size (100M+ IPs, 200+ countries) is the vendor's claim.
binding_note: The GB product is metered per GB; the by-port unlimited product swaps the quota for a 5 Mbps per-port ceiling.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up page titled 'Create an account' offers Google sign-in; the form fields were not rendered in the capture, so whether an email code, phone or card is asked is unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: unverified: payment methods and refund rules were not readable on the pages captured. The /pricing path resolves to a page whose final URL is /404 while still returning the price index. unverified: no address was looked up, so the 'Native' and 'Dual NTT' registration classes of the static line are not checked (rung 5).
confidence_note: Prices, products and authentication methods are read from the vendor's own pages; pool size and class labels are vendor statements.
